title: Temporarily use Codex direct implementation without Claude
objective: Persist the user-requested temporary Codex-only execution mode so routine Closure work and CI repairs do not depend on unavailable Claude, while preserving all current scope, evidence, review, CI, merge and delivery checks.
architecture: On 2026-11-23 the user explicitly authorized Codex direct implementation and asked to suspend the Claude-guided mode for the coming months. Record this override in the existing project entry points; resumption requires explicit user instruction. Codex directly implements and reviews this task without claiming separate Claude or human approval.

Add a trusted implementation_executor setting with codex and claude modes; preserve legacy claude behaviour when omitted. Codex mode skips every Claude preflight/auth/model invocation, freezes the same isolated task and returns AWAITING_CODEX_IMPLEMENTATION.

Repair/CI feedback stays bound to the exact current head and frozen config. Codex mode invalidates previous review_path and returns structured head-bound feedback to the active Codex. It does not generate fake implementation reports, packets, test results or automatic PASS.

Keep the existing check-command allowlist, completion policy and all head/base/spec/report/log-hash, PR, current-head CI, merge and clean-delivery protections. Unknown executor values fail before any model invocation.

Separate this independent execution-mode change from the Spine evaluation, whose runtime licensing is still unconfirmed. This task contains no model assets or Spine dependency and is authorized to complete ordinary CI/merge/delivery. Preserve the dirty legacy checkout and the current running application.
non_goals: No real model calls, alternate billing, credentials or private configuration changes.
No weakening of tests, review or merge guards; no automatic resumption of Claude, no migration of unrelated business changes.
No Spine code/assets, local application activation or changes to its voice/chat/weather behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: In trusted codex mode, doctor and task preparation work without Claude preflight/auth/model calls and do not claim implementation or checks have completed.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Offline fake-CLI tests, no auth/invocation markers, AWAITING_CODEX_IMPLEMENTATION state and absent packet/report; actual local doctor output.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Codex repair feedback is bound to the current head, previous review is invalidated, and existing scope/check/review/CI/merge/delivery protections remain effective.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Exact-head repair tests plus the existing workflow guard suite, code review and unmodified completion policy.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Project instructions persist the explicit temporary override, legacy Claude mode remains compatible, and the project passes existing Java and build checks without real models.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Instruction diff, full offline tests, workflow validation and package build. Exact-head PR/main CI and clean merged delivery remain separate mandatory completion-policy gates.

risks: The active Codex still has to implement, test and create truthful evidence; a prepared state is not completion.
The override is temporary and must not silently resume Claude; old frozen runs preserve their original executor configuration.
rollback: After an explicit user request to restore Claude, set the trusted executor back to claude and remove the temporary override notices; do not silently change old frozen runs.
